note: 100 unseen scenarios per role, played against mixed rule-based opponents. Score counts a failed deal as 0. Buyer and seller scores are not comparable with each other.

versions.name: v0
versions.desc: Imitates the rule-based teacher. Often tries to accept offers outside its limits.

versions.name: v1
versions.desc: Prompt states 'within your limits: YES/NO'. Mistakes drop, but it refuses too many deals.

versions.name: Hybrid
versions.desc: Rules decide accepts, the model proposes counteroffers.

versions.name: Final
versions.desc: Hybrid plus a concession floor in the last two rounds.

model_vs_model.detail: Closure on feasible deals when both sides are fine-tuned agents (84 feasible scenarios): 71% before the concession floor, 100% after.

assist.name: Mandate parser
assist.result: 49/51 on my regression set, 9/11 on a fresh set. Misses: hours read as days, 'no preference' read as speed, a dropped ideal delivery.

assist.name: Message narrator
assist.result: 100% of 100 validation messages kept the exact price and days (checked by code).

caveats: Differences under about 0.03 are noise at 100 scenarios.
The mandate parser tests were written by the same person who wrote the training templates, so its scores are optimistic.
'Mistakes' counts how often the rule engine or fallback had to replace a model move. No deal ever broke a limit.
